what_this_is: Every Layer 0 step, whether it runs by itself today, and the staged job for each manual one. A staged job is written and tested but NOT installed in any crontab: installing it is the integrator's step, and jobs marked owner_gated run only on the owner's say-so.

hosts.build_pod: the only deploy host; heavy work under flock /workspace/locks/heavy.lock
hosts.oracle: oracle-micro-2; light streaming jobs only; holds the board-sign caller token and the HF token

steps.pin_rule: a pending proof whose sha256 another tracked file pins, or that has a <subject>.ots.json sidecar, is NOT upgraded by the job; the pinning producer re-emits first. The derived public/interop/ots/manifest.json is rebuilt in the same commit and the deploy gate scripts/pod-loops/root_ots_manifest_gate.py must pass; llms.txt is regenerated only when canon llms.txt was fresh before the job
steps.why_pin_rule: the first job test (15:57Z) would have landed 41 upgraded proofs whose old digests 18 other files pinned (ots-state sidecars, the 2026-09-28 root witness, census records, test fixtures), 18 of them under public/interop without the manifest rebuild the deploy gate requires

The 25 proofs are the last commit on lane/layer0-20260928
